title: De-escalation Immunotherapy mAintenance Duration Trial for Stage IV Lung Cancer Patients With Disease Control After Chemo-immunotherapy Induction
target_population: Treatment-naive stage IV (metastatic) NSCLC patients, aged 18 to <75 years, ECOG PS 0-1, who achieve disease control after first-line platinum-doublet chemotherapy plus pembrolizumab induction, eligible for randomization to a de-escalated immunotherapy maintenance strategy (continued pembrolizumab vs observation).
intervention_summary: First-line induction with platinum-doublet chemotherapy (paclitaxel-carboplatin for SCC, or pemetrexed-platinum for non-SCC) plus pembrolizumab for 6 cycles/27 weeks; patients with confirmed disease control and no treatment-limiting toxicity are randomized 1:1 to continuation of pembrolizumab (± pemetrexed maintenance for non-SCC) until progression/unacceptable toxicity/2 years, or to observation (± pemetrexed for non-SCC).

rules.text: Subjects must have signed and dated an IRB/IEC approved written informed consent form, obtained before any protocol-related procedures not part of normal subject care
Subjects must be willing and able to comply with scheduled visits, treatment schedule, and laboratory testing
Patients with histologically confirmed metastatic NSCLC (Stage IV according to 8th classification TNM, UICC 2015); cytologically-proven NSCLC allowed if a cytoblock has been prepared
PD-L1 tumor content as assessed locally by the investigator center
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group Performance Status (ECOG PS) of 0 or 1
Weight loss < 10% within 3 months of study entry
No prior systemic anticancer therapy (including EGFR or ALK inhibitors) given as primary therapy for advanced or metastatic disease
Age ≥ 18 years
Age < 75 years
Life expectancy > 3 months
Measurable tumor disease by CT or MRI per RECIST 1.1 criteria

The Investigator must confirm prior to enrolment that the patient has adequate tumor tissue available, exploitable for molecular analysis; if archival tissue is insufficient or unavailable, patient may still be eligible upon discussion with IFCT
Tumor sample must not be from locations previously radiated; sample must be 1 block or at least 7 unstained slides of analyzable tissue
Creatinine Clearance ≥ 45 mL/min (Cockcroft or MDRD or CKD-epi)
Neutrophils ≥ 1500/mm3
Platelets ≥ 100 000/mm3
Hemoglobin ≥ 9 g/dL
AST < 3x ULN (patients with hepatic metastases or Gilbert's syndrome must have AST ≤ 5x ULN)
ALT < 3x ULN (patients with hepatic metastases or Gilbert's syndrome must have ALT ≤ 5x ULN)
Total bilirubin < 2x ULN (patients with hepatic metastases or Gilbert's syndrome must have baseline total bilirubin ≤ 2x ULN)

Women of childbearing potential (WOCBP) and sexually active should use an efficacious contraception method within the 28 days preceding the first dose and during the 6 months following the last dose of treatment
Women must have a negative serum or urine pregnancy test (minimum sensitivity 25 IU/L or equivalent units of HCG) prior to the start of study drug
For Male subjects who are sexually active with WOCBP, an efficacious contraception method should be used during the treatment and during the 6 months following the last dose
Patient has national health insurance coverage

Small cell lung cancer or tumors with mixed histology including a SCLC component (sarcomatoid histology allowed; large cell neuroendocrine lung cancer with molecular features of SCLC i.e. Rb loss with TP53 mutation not eligible; other neuroendocrine large cell subtypes with adenocarcinoma features e.g. STK11 or K-Ras mutations are eligible)

Known EGFR activating tumor mutation (deletion LREA in exon 19, L858R or L861X mutations in exon 21, G719A/S mutation in exon 18, exon 20 insertion) or HER2 exon 20 insertion (either tissue or plasma cfDNA mutation)
Known ALK, ROS1, RET, NTRK, NRG1 gene rearrangement as assessed by immunohistochemistry, FISH or NGS sequencing

Previous or active cancer within the previous 3 years (except for treated carcinoma in situ of the cervix, or basal cell skin cancer treated or not); patients with a prostate adenocarcinoma history within the previous 3 years could be included only if localized prostate cancer with good prognostic factors per d'Amico classification (≤T2a, Gleason ≤6, PSA ≤10 ng/mL) treated curatively (surgery or radiotherapy, without chemotherapy)
Superior vena cava syndrome persisting despite VCS stenting

Radiotherapy needed at initiation of tumour treatment, except bone palliative radiotherapy on a painful or compressive metastasis, respecting 1 week delay between the end of radiotherapy and the beginning of treatment

Symptomatic untreated brain metastasis (without previous whole brain radiotherapy or stereotactic ablative brain radiotherapy or without surgical resection); at least 2 weeks delay between the end of radiotherapy and the beginning of induction immunotherapy should be respected; asymptomatic brain metastasis not needing corticosteroids greater than 10 mg prednisone equivalent daily or mannitol infusions are allowed
History of previous primary immunodeficiency
Organ transplantation needing an immunosuppressive treatment
Any immunosuppressive drug within 28 days before randomization date
History of severe toxicity (grade 3/4) by immune mechanism linked to another immunotherapy treatment

Systemic treatment with corticosteroids with greater dose than 10 mg prednisone equivalent daily, within 14 days before initiation of the immunotherapy induction (inhaled, nasal or topic corticosteroids are allowed)

History of active autoimmune disease including but not limited to rheumatoid polyarthritis, myasthenia, autoimmune hepatitis, systemic Lupus, Wegener's granulomatosis, vascular thrombosis associated with antiphospholipid syndrome, Sjogren's syndrome with interstitial pulmonary disease, recent Guillain-Barré syndrome, multiple sclerosis, vasculitis, or glomerulonephritis (patients with type I diabetes, hypothyroidism, immune cutaneous disease (vitiligo, psoriasis, alopecia), benign rheumatoid polyarthritis not needing immunosuppressive systemic treatment, benign sicca syndrome without interstitial pulmonary disease, or fully reversible past Guillain-Barré syndrome with no systemic immunosuppressive treatment during the last 20 years are allowed)
Active inflammatory intestinal disease (Crohn disease, Hemorrhagic recto-colitis, coeliac disease) or any serious chronic intestinal disease with uncontrolled diarrhea
Active uncontrolled infection including tuberculosis (past tuberculosis not a contraindication if treated ≥6 months with anti-tuberculosis antibiotics)
Known acute viral hepatitis B according to serological tests (patients with serological sequelae of cured viral hepatitis are allowed)
Known acute viral hepatitis C according to serological tests (patients with serological sequelae of cured viral hepatitis are allowed)
Known HIV infection
Living attenuated vaccine received within the 30 previous days
Previous treatment with anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, Anti-CTLA4 or any ICI antibody

Previous treatment with chemotherapy for lung cancer (exception: if patient has lung adenocarcinoma, previous cisplatin treatment for another cancer type with squamous histology such as Head and Neck or bladder may be allowed if sponsor accepts and blood tests are normal)
Congestive uncontrolled cardiac failure
Uncontrolled cardiac arrythmia
Uncontrolled ischemic cardiac disease (unstable angina or history of myocardial infarction within the previous 6 months)
History of stroke within the 6 previous months
Patients with a significant cardiac history, even if controlled, must have LVEF > 50% (excluded if LVEF ≤ 50%)
Pre-existing moderate or severe lung interstitial disease as assessed by the diagnosis CT-scan
Inability to comply with study and/or follow-up procedures for family, social, geographic or psychological reasons
Pregnant, lactating, or breastfeeding women
Patients deprived of liberty by judicial or administrative decision
Patient who is subject to legal protection or who is unable to express his will

parsing_notes:
구조화된 CT.gov 필드는 maximum_age=74 Years이나 원문 텍스트는 '<75 years'로 기재되어 있어 I9는 원문 기준(age<75)을 그대로 사용함(동일한 의미). ECOG 'PS 0 or 1'은 field=ecog, operator<=, value=1로 단일 비교로 환산함(0과 1 모두 포함). AST/ALT/총빌리루빈 기준은 ULN 배수(상대값)로 제시되어 value를 채우지 못하고 structured_evaluable=false로 처리함; 간전이/길버트증후군 환자에 대한 완화된 기준(5xULN)은 각 lab 규칙 text에 함께 기술함. E1(SCLC/LCNEC 아형), E4(전립선암 예외), E13(자가면역질환 허용 예외), E21(시스플라틴 예외) 등은 원문에 포함된 세부 예외 조항을 하나의 규칙 text에 통합하여 기술함. 코호트(군) 구분은 무작위 배정 후 치료 arm 차이일 뿐 적격 기준 자체가 분리되어 있지 않으므로 cohorts는 빈 목록으로 처리함.
[코드 검증] I16: 비교값 100000이 원문에 없음 (lab:platelets >= 100000) -> LLM 판정으로 전환
